name: punctate palmoplantar keratoderma type III
description: a rare condition in which there are small firm warty or pearly papules on the sides of the hands and feet. They were first described by Costa in 1953, hence are sometimes referred to as Costa’s acrokeratoelastoidosis. Acrokeratoelastoidosis is considered a form of punctate palmoplantar keratoderma.
